title: Nirvanium
description: Simply fast and elegant, it's in the name.
body:
# ✨Have it all in **one click**.
![Enhanced](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe0a2b19a0f0874d415e85865094491ddc05df87.png)
**Nirvanium** is comprised of the most powerful optimization mods that is built on the Fabric modloader to squeeze out every last frame-it also includes tweaks and visual overhauls that enhance your vanilla experience.

## ⭐Standout Features:
- 🪶**Lightweight** with a **resource efficient Modlist**, perfect for low end devices
  
- 🖼️**Recreates Minecraft trailer look** without shaders.
  
- ⚡**Greatly optimised** refrenced from **Fabulously Optimised** and other leading Modpacks.
  
- 🏃‍♂️**Stunning Animation reworks** with **Punchy! and Fresh Animations**
  
- 🧩**Quality of life Mods** like **Resourceify, Tweakaroo, Zoomify and Mouse Tweaks**
  
- 🌍**Atmospheric and Terrain Enhancements** via **Terralith, Atmospherics, Subtle Effects, Particle Interactions,  Sound Physics Remastered and Sounds**
- 🖌️**Reworked UI and Seamless World Loading** with **Fancy Menu** and Several Resource packs
  
**All credit goes to the respective Mod creators who poured their heart and soul into into each and every one of the included mods, resource packs or shaders.**
